title: Advanced Gift
description: Easier gift giving without falling into teleport traps!
body:
Tired of having to send a teleport request to a player to give them a gift? Don't want to risk falling into a death trap when teleporting to a player? Just want an easy way to send gifts? **Then this may be for you!**

With **Advanced Gift**, the players can
- Send any holdable items to other players from any distance
- Attach a message to the gift
- Block gifts from a specific player or everyone
  
For server managers the plugin also offers
- Ability to spy on gift transactions
- Option to set a command cooldown on gifts
- Option to restrict gift transactions per world or per world group
- Option to blacklist gift transactions entirely from a world
- Option to block certain words in gift message
- Customizable plugin messages (_Currently the plugin has built-in translations for en_US and sas_SY. You may submit a translation file for another locale on Github or Discord._)

### Commands:
> **/gift <player> <amount | all> <message>**  
>   Send the item in hand to the targeted player, with an optional amount and an optional message.
>   For now, amount is required if you want to include a message.
> 
> **/gifttoggle**  
>   Block or allow gifts in general
> 
> **/giftblock <player>**  
>   Block gifts from a specific player
> 
> **/giftblocklist**  
>   Check who are blocked, with an option to clear the entire list
> 
> **/giftspy**  
>   Secretly view gift transactions between players
> 
> **/agreload**  
>   Reload configuration files
> 
> **/agtranslate <locale>**  
>   Copy the plugin's language file to disk for customization, with optional locale. If a locale is given, the name of the copied file will include it.
> 
### Permissions:
> **advancedgift.gift.send**  
>   Required to use /gift command. Defaulted to everyone.
> 
> **advancedgift.gift.message**  
>   Required to attach a message to the gift. Defaulted to everyone.
> 
> **advancedgift.gift.spy**  
>   Required to use /giftspy. Defaulted to opped players.
> 
> **advancedgift.bypass.cooldown**  
>   Bypass the cooldown set on /gift.
> 
> **advancedgift.bypass.world.restriction**  
>   Bypass the restriction on gifts between worlds.
> 
> **advancedgift.bypass.world.blacklist**  
>   Bypass the ban on gifts from and to the blacklisted worlds.
> 
> **advancedgift.bypass.vanish**  
>   Allow sending gifts to hidden players. Defaulted to opped players.
> 
> **advancedgift.reload**  
>   Required to use /agreload. Defaulted to opped players.
> 
> **advancedgift.translate**  
>   Required to use /agtranslate. Defaulted to opped players.
